title: MeshCore Station · Radio Operations

panels.title: RADIO LINK
panels.description: Collector heartbeat and serial connection. ONLINE confirms the collector is connected, not mesh delivery.

panels.title: RX PACKETS · BOOT
panels.description: Cumulative successfully received RF packets since T114 boot; may reset on power cycle.

panels.title: TX PACKETS · BOOT
panels.description: Cumulative transmitted packets reported by T114, not confirmations of remote reception.

panels.title: NOISE FLOOR
panels.description: Last measured noise floor in the past 10 minutes. Lower (more negative) is generally quieter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, noise_floor::double precision AS value FROM samples WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' AND noise_floor IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: KNOWN NODES
panels.description: Real contact inventory in PostgreSQL; RF packet count and contact count are different metrics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(detail->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'

panels.title: OPEN ALERTS
panels.description: Unresolved application alerts. Green at zero; higher values require review.

panels.title: RX traffic & receive errors · packets / interval
panels.description: Each bar is the number of changes within the displayed interval; resets and missing samples are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH source AS (
 SELECT ts, packets_rx AS rx,
    packets_tx AS tx,
    NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'recv_errors', '')::double precision AS err,
    NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'flood_rx', '')::double precision AS flood_rx,
    NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'direct_rx', '')::double precision AS direct_rx,
    NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'flood_tx', '')::double precision AS flood_tx,
    NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'direct_tx', '')::double precision AS direct_tx,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(stats->'core'->>'uptime_secs','')::double precision,uptime) AS radio_uptime
 FROM samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
), adjacent AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_ts,
 LAG(radio_uptime) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_uptime,
 LAG(rx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_rx,
    LAG(tx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_tx,
    LAG(err) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_err,
    LAG(flood_rx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_flood_rx,
    LAG(direct_rx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_direct_rx,
    LAG(flood_tx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_flood_tx,
    LAG(direct_tx) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS prior_direct_tx
 FROM source
), deltas AS (
 SELECT ts,
 CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND rx IS NOT NULL AND prior_rx IS NOT NULL AND rx >= prior_rx THEN rx - prior_rx END AS rx,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND tx IS NOT NULL AND prior_tx IS NOT NULL AND tx >= prior_tx THEN tx - prior_tx END AS tx,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND err IS NOT NULL AND prior_err IS NOT NULL AND err >= prior_err THEN err - prior_err END AS err,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND flood_rx IS NOT NULL AND prior_flood_rx IS NOT NULL AND flood_rx >= prior_flood_rx THEN flood_rx - prior_flood_rx END AS flood_rx,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND direct_rx IS NOT NULL AND prior_direct_rx IS NOT NULL AND direct_rx >= prior_direct_rx THEN direct_rx - prior_direct_rx END AS direct_rx,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND flood_tx IS NOT NULL AND prior_flood_tx IS NOT NULL AND flood_tx >= prior_flood_tx THEN flood_tx - prior_flood_tx END AS flood_tx,
    CASE WHEN prior_ts IS NOT NULL AND ts - prior_ts <= INTERVAL '10 minutes' AND (radio_uptime IS NULL OR prior_uptime IS NULL OR radio_uptime >= prior_uptime) AND direct_tx IS NOT NULL AND prior_direct_tx IS NOT NULL AND direct_tx >= prior_direct_tx THEN direct_tx - prior_direct_tx END AS direct_tx
 FROM adjacent
)
 SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,$__interval),
 SUM(rx)::double precision AS "Valid RX",
 SUM(err)::double precision AS "RX errors"
 FROM deltas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: RF receive composition · since boot
panels.description: Last reported cumulative radio breakdown; counts are not individual decoded chat messages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'flood_rx','')::double precision AS "Flood RX", NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'direct_rx','')::double precision AS "Direct RX" FROM (SELECT stats FROM samples WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) s

panels.title: RF transmit composition · since boot
panels.description: Flood TX includes Public channel broadcasts. A radio TX counter increase is not proof another node heard it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'flood_tx','')::double precision AS "Flood TX", NULLIF(stats->'packets'->>'direct_tx','')::double precision AS "Direct TX" FROM (SELECT stats FROM samples WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) s

panels.title: Signal environment · noise floor & RSSI (dBm)
panels.description: RSSI and SNR are the last reported measurements (not an always-current packet). SNR uses the right-hand dB axis when available.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, noise_floor::double precision AS "Noise floor", rssi::double precision AS "Last RSSI" FROM samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.description: Reported firmware uptime since last reboot; restarts naturally reset this metric.

panels.title: TELEMETRY AGE
panels.description: Seconds since last radio telemetry sample; stale data can make other current readings unreliable.

panels.title: Message activity · received vs sent
panels.description: Only real messages. Outgoing messages represent radio-accepted submissions, not confirmed remote delivery.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,$__interval),
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='in')::double precision AS "Received",
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='out')::double precision AS "Sent attempts"
 FROM messages WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND COALESCE(meta->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most active channels & direct traffic
panels.description: Message record counts within the selected time range, grouped by channel or direct conversation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN kind='direct' THEN 'Direct' ELSE 'Channel #' || target END AS "Destination",
 COUNT(*)::double precision AS "Messages"
 FROM messages WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND COALESCE(meta->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Recent real messages · latest 20
panels.description: Messages stored in PostgreSQL. Radio-accepted outgoing messages are not delivery receipts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "Time", CASE WHEN direction='in' THEN 'Received' ELSE 'Outgoing' END AS "Direction",
 CASE WHEN kind='channel' THEN 'Ch #' || target ELSE 'Direct' END AS "Route",
 COALESCE(NULLIF(sender,''),'Unknown') AS "Sender",
 LEFT(REPLACE(body,E'\n',' '),140) AS "Message",status AS "Status"
 FROM messages WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND COALESCE(meta->>'simulated','false') <> 'true' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Message outcomes · all time
panels.description: All-time real message record states; Channel sent means accepted by radio, not received remotely.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='in')::double precision AS "Received",
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='out' AND status='sent')::double precision AS "Channel sent",
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='out' AND status IN ('sent_unconfirmed','queued','running'))::double precision AS "Direct pending",
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='out' AND status='acknowledged')::double precision AS "Acknowledged",
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE direction='out' AND status IN ('failed','error'))::double precision AS "Failed"
 FROM messages WHERE COALESCE(meta->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'

panels.title: Known nodes · by role
panels.description: Saved radio-discovered contacts only. This is not a count of RF packets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE role
 WHEN 'client' THEN 'Companion'
 WHEN 'repeater' THEN 'Repeater'
 WHEN 'room_server' THEN 'Room server'
 WHEN 'sensor' THEN 'Sensor'
 ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Node type",
 COUNT(*)::double precision AS "Nodes"
 FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(detail->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Latest known contacts
panels.description: Last observed is based on reported advertisements; a contact refresh alone is not a new RF observation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LEFT(name,48) AS "Node", CASE role
 WHEN 'client' THEN 'Companion' WHEN 'repeater' THEN 'Repeater'
 WHEN 'room_server' THEN 'Room server' WHEN 'sensor' THEN 'Sensor' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Type",
 last_seen AS "Last observed",first_seen AS "First recorded",
 LEFT(public_key,14) AS "Public key prefix"
 FROM contacts WHERE COALESCE(detail->>'simulated','false') <> 'true'
 ORDER BY last_seen DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

panels.title: Latest RX activity · decoded events vs counters
panels.description: Counter intervals are aggregate radio statistics, not individual frames. Identified events appear only when the firmware/SDK exposes them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "Time",
 CASE kind
 WHEN 'channel' THEN 'Channel decoded' WHEN 'direct' THEN 'Direct decoded'
 WHEN 'advert' THEN 'Advertisement' WHEN 'new_contact' THEN 'New contact'
 WHEN 'counter_delta' THEN 'Counter interval' WHEN 'counter_reset' THEN 'Counter reset'
 ELSE kind END AS "Event",
 CASE WHEN channel IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE 'Ch #' || channel END AS "Channel",
 NULLIF(source,'') AS "Source",
 count AS "RX packets (interval)",errors AS "RX errors (interval)",
 rssi AS "RSSI",snr AS "SNR"
 FROM rx_activity ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Last-packet SNR history · dB
panels.description: SNR is returned by firmware when available. Blank means no SNR sample; never derived from RSSI minus noise.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, snr::double precision AS "Last SNR" FROM samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND snr IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Radio resets · selected time range
panels.description: Count of radio uptime decreases. A collector restart alone is not treated as a radio reset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH seen AS (
SELECT ts, COALESCE(NULLIF(stats->'core'->>'uptime_secs','')::double precision, uptime) AS radio_uptime
FROM samples WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND COALESCE((stats->>'simulated')::boolean,false)=false
), intervals AS (
SELECT radio_uptime, lag(radio_uptime) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS previous_uptime FROM seen
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN radio_uptime < previous_uptime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)::double precision AS "Detected resets" FROM intervals

description: Focused RF operations dashboard for USB-powered T114. Real messages only; reset-aware packet deltas and separate decoded RX events.
